name: Sophia Dantes
source:
Your younger sister, a energetic yet reclusive girl who likes to spend her time playing video games. [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]You[/url] used to be very close with Sophia but she shut everyone out, you included, after your [url=https://vndb.org/c148155]father[/url]'s death. You'd hoped your leaving would've let your family start to heal, but for Sophia it seemed to only make her more of a shut-in...
